mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the federal funds rate signals tightening monetary policy, compressing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous upward movements in GDP (demand) and industrial production (supply) indices signal robust economic expansion, enhancing corporate earnings and investor confidence, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60d returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in CPIAUCSL below 2% signals controlled inflation, reinforcing market confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 6-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the CPIAUCSL index signals accelerating inflation, prompting central banks to raise interest rates and eroding equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained crossing of GDPC1 above 18,000 billions of chained 2017 dollars signals robust economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in employment (PAYEMS) indices signal coordinated monetary easing and labor market strength, amplifying corporate profits and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60d returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained drop in UNRATE below 3.5% signals labor market resilience, countering the negative effects of higher interest rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 6-month rolling window.
